message: Possible hardcoded secret — use environment variable

evaluator_config.message_template: Possible hardcoded secret — use environment variable

rationale: Secrets in source code are visible to everyone with repository access. They persist in git history forever. They are the most common cause of credential leakage.
remediation: Use environment variables or a secrets management system. Never hardcode secrets in source code.

guidance.explanation: The correct version reads secrets from environment variables. The incorrect version hardcodes a secret in source code, visible to everyone with repository access.
